question: Should ClawHub accept publisher follow notifications as core product/API surface now, and should this notification slice wait for the follow graph and controls PRs to land first?
rationale: The PR creates new private notification state and a user-facing follow-notification product boundary, which automation cannot approve without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept after stack, fix, and proof
options.body: Proceed only after the base follow API and controls PRs are resolved, the package visibility gate is fixed, and contributor runtime proof is added.

options.title: Review the stack together
options.body: Hold this PR while maintainers review the follow API, controls, and notifications as one product boundary.

options.title: Pause the notification slice
options.body: Keep or close this branch if maintainers do not want publisher follow notifications in core yet.

recommendation.title: Accept after stack, fix, and proof
recommendation.body: Proceed only after the base follow API and controls PRs are resolved, the package visibility gate is fixed, and contributor runtime proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen has the strongest current-main history across the publish paths, schema/package API, retention, and Convex surfaces this feature extends.
